say:5:1810554001:0.text: Humans, wanted fugitives, and a criminal who stole the Void Relic... Novaris is full of surprises.
say:5:1810554001:0.source_cn: 生者、通缉犯、抢夺圣器的罪人……诺珐斯真是卧虎藏龙。
say:5:1810554001:0.male: Humans, wanted fugitives, and a criminal who stole the Void Relic... Novaris is full of surprises.
say:5:1810554001:0.female: Humans, wanted fugitives, and a criminal who stole the Void Relic... Novaris is full of surprises.

say:6:1810554002:0.text: Secure the area. Let no one escape.
say:6:1810554002:0.source_cn: 抓住他们，一个都不许漏。

say:7:1810554003:0.text: Be careful of that one—<style="stress"><player_name></style>. The Void Relic is in his hands.
say:7:1810554003:0.male: Be careful of that one—<style="stress"><player_name></style>. The Void Relic is in his hands.
say:7:1810554003:0.female: Be careful of that one—<style="stress"><player_name></style>. The Void Relic is in her hands.

say:8:1810554004:1.text: Then he's our primary target. Reclaim that relic, and the Bantus Empire will be able to crush Esperia.
say:8:1810554004:1.male: Then he's our primary target. Reclaim that relic, and the Bantus Empire will be able to crush Esperia.
say:8:1810554004:1.female: Then she's our primary target. Reclaim that relic, and the Bantus Empire will be able to crush Esperia.

say:11:1810554005:0.text: And how do you propose we do that? You know what it does. Our precious Bantus nobility guards their second lives like delicate, fading flowers. None of those cowards have the stomach to face a relic like that.
say:11:1810554005:0.source_cn: 拿回？怎么拿回？班题斯的贵族们爱护自己的第二段生命就如...
say:11:1810554005:0.male: And how do you propose we do that? You know what it does. Our precious Bantus nobility guards their second lives like delicate, fading flowers. None of those cowards have the stomach to face a relic like that.
say:11:1810554005:0.female: And how do you propose we do that? You know what it does. Our precious Bantus nobility guards their second lives like delicate, fading flowers. None of those cowards have the stomach to face a relic like that.

say:12:1810554006:1.text: And let's be honest, Grezhul... that includes you.
say:12:1810554006:1.source_cn: 即便是你也一样，格瑞泽尔勒。

say:13:1810554007:0.text: Watch your tongue. Especially on a battlefield.
say:13:1810554007:0.source_cn: 不要挑衅我，尤其是在战场上。

say:14:1810554008:0.text: Oh? Was that a threat? I'm merely pointing out that I am nothing like you hypocritical, dusty old-bloods.
say:14:1810554008:0.source_cn: 这怎么能算挑衅呢？余只是想告诉你，余和你们这些虚伪的旧...

say:15:1810554009:1.text:
I'll handle <style="stress"><player_name></style> myself.
Consider it a rare display of my... absolute loyalty to the Fallen King.
say:15:1810554009:1.male:
I'll handle <style="stress"><player_name></style> myself.
Consider it a rare display of my... absolute loyalty to the Fallen King.
say:15:1810554009:1.female:
I'll handle <style="stress"><player_name></style> myself.
Consider it a rare display of my... absolute loyalty to the Fallen King.

narration:17:18010581:0.text: Grezhul, Tephesia, and the others from Bantus are closing in. A battle is about to break out.
narration:17:18010581:0.source_cn: 班题斯的格瑞泽尔勒和苔佩希等人已经逼近你们，战斗一触即发。
